# The ArdourCraft SMP Modpack
This modpack was made by ArdourOfAmy for the ArdourCraft SMP, located in the Discord server in the invite to the right of this.

## Constituent stuff
* ArdourCraft Unicode resource pack
* Customizable Player Models mod
* Simple Voice Chat mod
